meta.name: firebase-hosting-basics
meta.description: Deploys and configures classic Firebase Hosting for static websites, single-page apps (SPAs), and microservices. Use when deploying static sites/SPAs, setting up custom domains, configuring firebase.json hosting settings (redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site), or managing preview channels. Don't use for Firebase App Hosting (Next.js/SSR), Auth, Firestore queries/rules, Data Connect, or Crashlytics.

copy.tagline: 将静态网站和单页应用部署到 Firebase Hosting,并配置域名与托管规则
copy.tagline_en: Deploy static sites/SPAs to Firebase Hosting, set up domains and redirects.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you deploy static sites to Firebase Hosting and need domain/redirect config.

howto.what: 指导你配置和部署经典 Firebase Hosting，支持静态网站、单页应用和微服务。可设置重定向、重写、标头、多站点，执行部署、预览渠道与本地模拟。
howto.when: 当你需要部署静态网站或 SPA、设置自定义域名、配置 firebase.json 托管设置（如重定向、重写、标头），或管理预览渠道时触发。不适用于 App Hosting、Auth、Firestore 等。

say.text: 帮我部署这个静态网站到 Firebase Hosting。
给 firebase.json 加一条重定向，把 /old 转到 /new。
为当前站点创建一个预览渠道，生成临时链接。

howto.what_en: Guides configuring and deploying classic Firebase Hosting for static sites, SPAs, and microservices. Covers redirects, rewrites, headers, multi-site settings in firebase.json, deployments, preview channels, and local emulation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to deploy a static site or SPA, set up a custom domain, configure firebase.json hosting settings (redirects, rewrites, headers, etc.), or manage preview channels. Not for App Hosting, Auth, Firestore, etc.

say_en.text: Deploy this static site to Firebase Hosting for me.
Add a redirect in firebase.json from /old to /new.
Create a preview channel for the current site.
